A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

(1) the spatial lag model with the standard weights matrix (containing only first-order neighbours) is not appropriate for the analysis of the NEG ‘wage’ model, as it is not capable of detecting the global trend; (2) the spatial lag models with global spatial weights matrices (containing both first- and second-order neighbours) and the spatial error model are more appropriate for the analysis; and (3) the spillover effects are more significant than the market potential effects.
